title: Frenzy (Fish)
wikitext:
[[image:FrenzyBlue.png|thumb|A frenzy]]
A piranha-like [[fish]] found mostly in tropical regions. They are ''not'' caught with the [[Fishing]] profession but actually are [[mob]]s that reside in the water and may attack you when you are going for a [[swim]]. Depending upon the [[zone]], their level can range from around 12 to 60 [[elite]].

[[Player]]s that win first place in the [[Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza]] can recieve a [[trinket]], the Hook of the Master Angler ([http://www.thottbot.com/?i=51848 ThottBot]), which allows them to transform into a Frenzy.
